case: MySQL/MariaDB ENUM and SET consumers across SQL modes
contract: Generated SQL export files replay with the same enum values under default, NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES, ANSI_QUOTES, their combination, STRICT_TRANS_TABLES, and STRICT_TRANS_TABLES with NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES on both engines.
ENUM and SET fixtures cover apostrophe and backslash labels, multiple selected SET members, literal NULL, empty text, and SQL NULL.
SQL files replay and typed CSV export/import preserve ENUM/SET values under the same six modes on both engines.
CSV uses a collision-free NULL marker so an empty SET stays distinct from SQL NULL; JSON preserves each value.
XML, HTML, and Markdown escape markup-shaped ENUM and SET labels under each of the six SQL modes.
XLSX refuses the empty SET text and leaves an existing destination unchanged.
Each mode checks native ENUM ordinals, SET masks, label bytes and both copied tables against the source.

mysql.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mysql --test integration enum_sql_mode_contract::value_contract_enum_and_set_consumers_survive_mysql_sql_modes -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

mariadb.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mysql --test integration enum_sql_mode_contract::value_contract_enum_and_set_consumers_survive_mariadb_sql_modes -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-mysql --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: SQL mode/session combinations beyond the six tested values and additional enum/SET consumers remain open.
This bounded case does not close B3 or qualify the 0.2.0 release.
